purpose: Test whether the temporal-position sensitivity isolated in Replication A covaries with the post-retention matched residual observed in Question B.

question_b_paired_analysis.comparison: natural MAE versus retention-matched MAE within the same episode and condition pair
report: 95% bootstrap CI of median paired reduction
question_b_paired_analysis.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the 9 family x pair tests

a_sensitivity_definition.value: mean MAE across the two directed temporal-position interventions and all three process blocks

primary_a_b_association.procedure: rank A sensitivity and B residual separately within each 10-episode stratum, center the ranks within stratum, then compute pooled Pearson correlation of centered ranks
primary_a_b_association.significance: 10000 permutations of B ranks within each family x condition-pair stratum

report: Spearman correlation within each family x condition-pair stratum
pooled raw Spearman correlation for description only

interpretation.positive_stratified_association: supports a link between A temporal-position sensitivity and B post-retention residual, but does not prove that temporal position is the sole cause of the B residual
interpretation.weak_or_null_association: suggests that additional post-retention mechanisms contribute materially to B residuals
